sources.method: Pick share and value score are SurvivorGrid's Week 6 grid as fetched Saturday Oct 17 (its spreads for a few games run about a point from our current lines, so its value score will differ slightly from one computed on ours). Notes cite ESPN, Yahoo, Hard Rock and Rotowire. Pick share varies a lot by site and by contest, so the notes show the range. Teams from the Thursday game (SEA/DEN) are omitted. No pool-specific ownership for Andy's Yahoo groups was available.

KC.note: Pick share 5-10% (ESPN 5%, SurvivorGrid 6%, Hard Rock 8%, Yahoo 10%). ESPN: low ownership and a good week to burn them (future value 4th). Rotowire: best in a small pool.

SF.note: Pick share 8-13% (ESPN 8%, SurvivorGrid 7.5%, Hard Rock 10%, Yahoo 13%). ESPN: highest future value on the board (1st), but this is their easiest remaining game per ESPN Analytics. Monday-night game.

LAR.note: Pick share by site: SurvivorGrid 39%, ESPN 33%, Yahoo 28%, Hard Rock 25%. ESPN: optimal in one-pick-per-week pools, especially small ones; in big pools or multi-pick weeks it prefers saving them (future value 5th).

NE.note: Pick share 17-21% (Hard Rock 17%, Yahoo 18%, ESPN 21%). ESPN's top choice for larger or multi-pick pools: 'the best chance all season to use New England' (future value 13th). Rotowire calls it a save candidate for big pools.

IND.note: Pick share 15-23% (ESPN 15%, Yahoo 14.5%, Hard Rock 23%). ESPN: a contrarian option because the Week 10 game will draw more chalk (future value 17th). Hard Rock's writer ranks the Colts first.

BUF.note: Pick share 3-4%. ESPN: recommended only for Splash, as a way to avoid the popular Week 11 game (future value 3rd). Rotowire: save for Week 11.

BAL.note: Pick share 1-3%. Rotowire flags the quarterback's ankle as still uncertain. Win chance is only ~61-63%.

CAR.note: Pick share 1-4%. Hard Rock's contrarian option; picking against Philadelphia at home is generally considered risky.

PIT.note: Pick share 1-2%. Pick'em-range game; not survivor-grade at this price.

JAX.note: Pick share 2-3%. Pick'em-range game in London; not survivor-grade at this price.
